# Scientific American

> > Scientific American (SciAm) is a leading science journalism publication offering digital and print subscriptions, published by Springer Nature America, Inc.

The site provides access to Scientific American's award-winning science journalism through various subscription plans, available on web, iOS, and Android platforms. Content covers the latest discoveries and insights across all scientific disciplines.

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm. | Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription plans with digital & print options
